encryption-key: Encryption key, you can generate one with 'python3 kedet keys make encryption'
auth-token-hmac-key: Auth token HMAC key, you can generate one with 'python3 kedet keys make hmac'
google-client-id: Google Ads and DV360 Client ID
google-client-secret: Google Ads and DV360 Client Secret
meta-login-config-id: Meta Login Configuration ID, you can leave empty when using mock backend
